sentences.en: I lost my temper with him because of his arrogance.
sentences.zh: 因为我对他傲慢的行为感到生气，所以和他发了脾气。

sentences.en: With these stupid attitudes, Maria only proves her own arrogance.
sentences.zh: 凭借这些愚蠢的态度，玛利亚只证明了自己的自大。

sentences.en: I have stopped working with him because of his arrogance.
sentences.zh: 因为他的傲慢，我已经停止和他的合作了。
